description: 國營臺灣鐵路股份有限公司-振興三倍券通訊交易適用業者名單 [railways and stations and telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 國營臺灣鐵路股份有限公司. 本資料集已於109年12月31日到期 提供資料包含：識別標章編號、提供機關名稱、特店對外名稱、特店網址、啟用日期、終止日期等欄位資料。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 國營臺灣鐵路股份有限公司. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2024-08-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
